'''July 2000 Huntsville tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Huntsville, AL on 8 July 2000. Andy won it. It is known from Tom Culpepper's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d985">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-08-huntsville-al-7-8-00d985/ huntsville-al-7-8-00], DeckTech (Tom "Gand" Culpepper, 8 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-08-huntsville-al-7-8-00d985/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Huntsville, AL
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' Andy
